source: Nakshatra Bootcamp Classes 5, 6 & 7 (Astro Vaibhav Gupta) - standard Vedic Jyotish reference, kept separate from BNN's own methodology

nakshatras.name: Ashwini
nakshatras.tagline: Possessing the swiftness of a horse, this star governs healing, vitality, and movement.
nakshatras.predictions: Highly active and fast-paced mind; prone to restlessness (Chanchal) and overthinking; frequent headaches from mental hyperactivity; deep need for movement and well-ventilated spaces. Prone to respiratory issues and sinus problems; afflictions by Rahu/Ketu may cause anxiety; 7th lord often indicates a spouse in the medical field.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Start projects, lay foundations; begin treatments, visit doctors; buy property, cars, or cycles; excellent for journeys.
nakshatras.remedies: Feed dogs with your own hands; donate medicines and consume Chyawanprash; plant and walk around a Peepal tree; practice Pranayama for anxiety.

nakshatras.name: Bharani
nakshatras.tagline: A portal for birth, death, and radical transformation. It bears the weight of life.
nakshatras.predictions: Acts as a powerful portal for birth and death; signals 'pending karma' or ancestral curse (Pitra Dosh); often related to past ill-treatment of females/children; can indicate complications with childbirth or single parenting. Fields of life/death: gynecology, nursing, or judiciary; deep creative potential if associated with Venus/Mercury; psychological intensity or depressive tendencies if afflicted; spouse may bring transformative conflicts.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Start art/design projects; IVF, fertility treatments; decluttering, deep cleaning; planting new life (gardening).
nakshatras.remedies: Chant 'Om Namah Shivaya' daily; offer sweets to Ma Kali in the evening; feed crows to resolve Pitra Dosh; recite the Mahamrityunjaya Mantra for health.

nakshatras.name: Krittika
nakshatras.tagline: Characterized by a sharp, cutting energy that seeks purity and truth.
nakshatras.predictions: Radiant appearance ('Tejas') but sharp speech; tendency to 'cut off' relationships abruptly; zero tolerance for injustice or undeserved situations; sudden breakups or career changes are common. Strong connection to foster care or adoption; father may be absent during early childhood; acts as a spotlight exposing hidden secrets or fraud; hidden talents often come to light during its active periods.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Finish pending work (clear backlogs); leadership and decisive action; regular fire rituals (Havan/Yagya) are highly auspicious; organizing community meals.
nakshatras.remedies: Perform Havan (fire rituals) to appease Agni; worship Kartikeya to protect the family; serve food to the needy (Annadaan); donate towards a girl's wedding.

nakshatras.name: Rohini
nakshatras.tagline: Centered on creation, growth, and intense desire. The favorite of the Moon.
nakshatras.predictions: Strong drive to create something unique (arts/business); often becomes a center of attraction or scrutiny; fluctuating emotions like the waxing/waning Moon; struggles with possessiveness or jealousy. Saturn: transport/aviation (delays before growth); Mercury: skills with fragrances/botany; Moon: enhances charm but risks scandal if afflicted. Core theme: 'Movement' and 'Instability.'
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Agriculture and planting; buying land, jewelry, garments; auspicious time for weddings; applying for travel documents (visa).
nakshatras.remedies: Chant 'Krishna, Krishna' all day; bathe with water from 5 temples; sprinkle holy water in the home; avoid jealousy and possessiveness.

nakshatras.name: Mrigashira
nakshatras.tagline: The eternal hunt for something elusive - spiritual truth, knowledge, or love.
nakshatras.predictions: The 'Searching Star' - constantly hunting for the elusive; restless wandering to 'reset' karma (forests/mountains); relationships involve a 'chasing' dynamic; often multiple partners or issues with in-laws. Gifted sense of smell (Soma connection); thrive in perfumes, essential oils, or healing herbs; experience sudden, life-altering 'plot twists'; research and investigation are key strengths.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Deep investigation and tech work; singing, writing, painting; tackle old/pending tasks; good for wandering/roaming.
nakshatras.remedies: Pray to Maa Parvati; listen to Lalita Sahasranama; donate milk/rice at a Shiva Temple; donate fodder to a cow shelter.

nakshatras.name: Ardra
nakshatras.tagline: A star of intense transformation and renewal through destruction, like a storm.
nakshatras.predictions: Events cause 'tears' or emotional release leading to clarity; high empathy but prone to emotional manipulation; governs technology, communication, and 'breaking' norms; prominent in hackers, IT professionals, and non-conformists. Carries 'Brahma Hatya' (rejection of the creator); conflicts with gurus, father figures, or authority; tendency towards unconventional relationships; often leads 'dual' lifestyles.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Destruction: end bad habits, declutter; legal: start lawsuits, confront issues; tech: buying new technology; research: deep, analytical work.
nakshatras.remedies: Chant 'Om Namah Shivaya'; listen to Shri Rudram; visit a Bhairav temple; visit Jyotirlingas (pilgrimage).

nakshatras.name: Punarvasu
nakshatras.tagline: Return of the Light. The ability to bounce back from failure like a cat.
nakshatras.predictions: Signifies 'return' - returning to old jobs or home; 'second chance' energy - failure followed by success; resilience: bouncing back like bamboo or a cat; profound optimism and recovery ability. Natives often act as healers or mentors; tendency to be overly complacent if afflicted; can indicate issues with the feet; delays in career/childbirth resolve favorably.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Buying vehicles/houses (assets); pilgrimages, spiritual journeys (travel); starting habits meant to repeat; laying foundations for investments.
nakshatras.remedies: Chant 'Shri Ram Jai Ram Jai Jai Ram'; water a Bamboo tree (resilience); wear light yellow or green; eat jaggery in the morning for disputes.

nakshatras.name: Pushya
nakshatras.tagline: The Nourisher. The most auspicious star for growth, but not for marriage.
nakshatras.predictions: Tendency for a 'plump' or rounded physique; deep love for milk, dairy, and baby food; thrive in hospitality, cooking, and caregiving; habit of eating slowly, 'chewing their cud.' Most auspicious star for business/gold (Guru-Pushya); considered unfavorable for marriage (Brihaspati myth); marital neglect - prioritizing work/duty over spouse; prefer wearing plain, unpatterned clothes.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Spirituality: meditation, Kundalini practices; business: start new ventures, buy gold; family: spend time with mother; service: feed cows, gift and nourish others.
nakshatras.remedies: Offer water, milk, and black sesame to Shiva; chant Vishnu Sahasranama.

nakshatras.name: Ashlesha
nakshatras.tagline: Deep mystique, entanglement, and the power of Kundalini energy.
nakshatras.predictions: Intense 'clinging' energy; difficulty letting go; firm grip, intense/hypnotic eyes, coiling posture; understanding of 'poison' - great doctors/therapists; uses trauma or psychological depth to heal. Risk of 'Sarpa Dosh' - skin issues, anxiety; complex family dynamics, especially with mother; material entanglement vs. spiritual enlightenment; worshiping nature/snakes brings protection.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Fierce action: lawsuits, aggressive strategy; mysticism: Kundalini work, deep meditation; strategy: scheming, political moves; healing: using 'poison' as medicine.
nakshatras.remedies: Offer milk to a male cat; offer water/milk to a Shivling; recite Vishnu Sahasranama for protection; chant 'Om Namah Shivaya' (4-32 rounds).

nakshatras.name: Magha
nakshatras.tagline: The Mighty. Connected to power, authority, and karmic lineage.
nakshatras.predictions: 'Karma Continuation' - carrying on the family profession; hereditary issues (health or status) passing down; upholding traditional values and family business; planets here indicate strong ancestral influence. Carries the weight of 'Pitra Dosh' (ancestral debt); unresolved past issues manifest in property/marriage; remedy lies in 'blocking' negative karma via rituals; success comes from honoring the past.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Events: public ceremonies, awards; legacy: restoring heirlooms, honoring elders; study: history, astrology, lineage; avoid: lending money, new tech.
nakshatras.remedies: Light a lamp for ancestors; offer a mustard oil lamp under a Peepal tree at sunset; donate sweet and salty food to the poor; chant the Mahamrityunjaya Mantra.

nakshatras.name: Purva Phalguni
nakshatras.symbol: Hammock or Front Legs of Bed
nakshatras.tagline: The fruit of the tree. Relaxation, enjoyment, and social connection.
nakshatras.predictions: Carefree, 'chilled out' nature loving comfort; may manifest as laziness or procrastination; feeling 'entitled' to success without immediate effort; balance between active creation and necessary rest. Natural matchmakers, wedding planners, and socializers; thrive in partnerships and unions; associated with the back/spine of the lion; prone to back pain or reproductive health concerns.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Love: romance, marriage, socializing; rest: vacations, leisure, relaxation; peace: reconciliation, harmony; avoid: harsh business, conflicts.
nakshatras.remedies: Worship Lakshmi; gift cosmetics; water an Ashoka tree; chant 'Om Cham Purva Phalguni...'; donate food/ration to priests.

nakshatras.name: Uttara Phalguni
nakshatras.tagline: Duty, commitment, and the support of friends.
nakshatras.predictions: The 'Social Connector' - excels at introducing people; carries the heavy weight of responsibility; gives like the Sun, often leading to 'burnout'; feels unappreciated or used by partners/society. Prone to eye ailments and back pain; stubborn, bull-like nature; fights persistently for friends or social causes; prioritizes formal relationships over casual ones.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Marriage: formalizing unions/weddings; founding: societies, organizations; charity: philanthropy, social service; avoid: lending, conflict, endings.
nakshatras.remedies: Offer water to Surya; recite the Gayatri Mantra; plant a Rose plant; chant 'Vishnu Vishnu' or Hare Krishna; focus on maintenance and preservation.

nakshatras.name: Hasta
nakshatras.tagline: Dexterity, skill, and the power to manifest through the hands.
nakshatras.predictions: 'Hasta Siddhi' (golden hands) - gifted in manual skills; excellence in surgery, painting, palmistry, or healing; channels solar energy through fingertips; sharp wit, mimicry, and talent for comedy. Agility can manifest as cunningness or 'sleight of hand'; potential for trickery (magicians, pickpockets); compulsive need to 'grasp' or hold onto things; buffalo symbol: great endurance but prone to lethargy.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Craft: painting, pottery, writing; healing: Reiki, massage, pranic healing; comedy: mimicry, jokes, humor; travel: short commutes.
nakshatras.remedies: Surya Namaskar at sunrise; clapping hands, laughter yoga; Gayatri Mantra (crucial); wear green or gold.

nakshatras.name: Chitra
nakshatras.tagline: The Brilliant One. The power to accumulate merit and give form to the formless.
nakshatras.predictions: The 'Architect': multi-skilled with a natural flair for design, engineering, and architecture; prowess in creating something tangible from a mere thought; excels in fashion, automobiles, and interior aesthetics; highly perfectionist in relationships with elevated standards for partners. Associated with weakened solar vitality (Vishwakarma myth); susceptibility to eye or immunity issues; afflictions can indicate conception challenges (IVF potential); delays in marriage often occur due to fixations on status or aesthetic perfection.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Creative: painting, sketching, artistic projects; decor: interior design, renovation, purchasing art; education: commencing new studies or training courses; scriptures: reading the Bhagavad Gita (especially on Full Moon days); avoid: marriage ceremonies and detailed investigations.
nakshatras.remedies: Vishwakarma: light a lamp to enhance technical and creative skill; donation: donate sketchbooks and pencils to children; Hanuman: offer multi-colored flowers to Lord Hanuman; focus: align life activities with design and aesthetics.

nakshatras.name: Swati
nakshatras.tagline: The Self-Going One. Associated with independence, flexibility, and movement.
nakshatras.predictions: Represents flexibility, autonomy, and scattering/dispersive energy; characterized by a restless mind or professions requiring frequent travel/aviation; the 'Sword' aspect provides the ability to cut through complex situations decisively; the sprout symbol bestows great resilience in adversity. Strong commercial intellect and desire for financial freedom (Libra influence); unconventional partnerships and marriages (Rahu influence); closely linked to Prana; afflictions trigger respiratory or Vata imbalances; vitality is restored through regular Pranayama.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Business: buying/selling, negotiating commercial transactions; social: networking, attending public events; education: learning new skills and techniques; avoid: unpredictable travel and initiating lawsuits.
nakshatras.remedies: Chant: recite 'Om Hanumate Namah' (specifically after 12:00 PM); yoga: practice Pranayama to harmonize and calm Vayu; evening: light a Diya for Goddess Durga; focus: cultivate breath control and mental centering.

nakshatras.name: Vishakha
nakshatras.tagline: The Star of Purpose. Forked energy that creates obsession and eventual victory.
nakshatras.predictions: Relentless drive to attain status and supremacy ('Indra's Throne'); forked energy creates a tension between two distinct paths (material vs. spiritual); ultimate success is realized later in life following an intense 'burning' transformative struggle (Agni); bestows power to accomplish seemingly unachievable feats. Bifurcated focus can trigger marital strain (ambition vs. love); tends to subordinate relational harmony to personal goals; vulnerable to deep-seated jealousy or fear of competitors (Indra's insecurity), leading to competitive friction or social isolation.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Focus: high-concentration assignments, coding, deep analytical tasks; competition: appearing for examinations, resolving disputes/arguments; backlog: clearing pending work efficiently; avoid: brand new beginnings and marriage ceremonies.
nakshatras.remedies: Agni: perform a small Havan or illuminate a pure Ghee lamp; temple: offer yellow bananas and white flowers to Lord Vishnu; donation: gift copper vessels to underprivileged individuals; chant: recite 'Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya'.

nakshatras.name: Anuradha
nakshatras.tagline: Following Radha. Blooming amidst adversity and the power of friendship.
nakshatras.predictions: Blossoming out of muddy, difficult circumstances into purity and distinction; success is frequently discovered far away from the birthplace or across foreign shores; flourishes through collaborative networks and alliances (Mitra); capable of working alongside opponents for shared goals. Rigorous, methodical, and disciplined mindset (Saturn in Scorpio); outstanding capabilities in research, data analysis, statistics, and occult sciences; devotional, worship-like orientation in personal relationships (Radha energy); prone to melancholy or feeling deeply misunderstood.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Foreign: immigration processes, foreign travel, international affairs; research: scientific investigations, occult studies, deep data analytics; social: networking, meeting spiritual mentors/gurus; avoid: marriage rites and new business inaugurations.
nakshatras.remedies: Donation: donate wheelchairs or walking aids (balancing Saturn/legs); Hanuman: offer red flowers and Sindoor for Mars; mantra: chant the Hare Krishna Mahamantra (fostering devotion); spirituality: engage in regular reading of the Bhagavad Gita.

nakshatras.name: Jyeshtha
nakshatras.tagline: The Eldest. Authority gained through struggle and protection of the status.
nakshatras.predictions: Naturally assumes patriarchal/matriarchal leadership; shoulders burdensome responsibilities; often experiences a feeling of being unappreciated (Alakshmi mythos); subject to the 'Indra Complex' (anxiety regarding the loss of position, power, or status); highly competitive and hyper-vigilant. Possesses '1000 Eyes' capability - excelling in auditing, surveillance, investigations, and law enforcement; sharp, stinging intellect (Mercury in Scorpio); must guard against paranoia and petty office/social politics; initial delays preceding substantial material success are standard.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Authority: taking control, executing high-level administrative tasks; sports: engaging in athletic competitions and physical tests; management: handling crisis resolution and damage control; avoid: romantic ventures, completely new start-ups, and scandalous situations.
nakshatras.remedies: Donation: donate red shoes to homeless/underprivileged individuals; worship: visit a Goddess Kali temple during evening hours; mantra: chant 'Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya'; focus: concentrate on stability, boundary protection, and resilience.

nakshatras.name: Mula
nakshatras.tagline: The Root. Uprooting the old to create the new. Intense transformation.
nakshatras.predictions: Relentless inner drive to investigate and uncover the absolute 'root' cause of matters (elite researchers/investigators); propensity for sudden uprooting events, crises, or betrayals that dismantle obsolete structures, serving as catalysts for profound spiritual awakening; characterized by early instability in finances or relationships. Afflictions suggest ancestral/genetic health issues, particularly concerning hips, thighs, or the sciatic nerve; karmic mandate requires addressing and resolving inherited ancestral patterns; life circumstances steer the native inexorably toward detachment.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Property: purchasing land, laying building foundations, construction work; deep work: high-level investigative work, research, root-cause analysis; exiting: resigning from toxic jobs, breaking detrimental habits; avoid: lending money and scheduling marriage events.
nakshatras.remedies: Lock remedy: donate iron locks or iron chains; Kali: offer a garland of fresh lemons to Goddess Kali; direction: burn fragrant dhoop/incense in the South-West direction; animals: regularly feed stray dogs.

nakshatras.name: Purva Ashadha
nakshatras.tagline: The Undefeated. Early victory and the purification of waters.
nakshatras.predictions: Inherent affinity for water bodies, swimming, and liquid mediums; health vulnerabilities involve fluid retention, kidney functions, or diabetes; the 'Winnowing Fan' gives an exceptional faculty for separating essential truths from extraneous noise, though it can also 'fan the flames' of conflict through stubbornness. Predilection for luxury, refinement, and the fine arts (Venus-Jupiter synthesis); operates with an 'Aparajita' (Invincible) mindset; early marriages are common; must consciously guard against being fickle or turbulent like shifting ocean tides.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Debt: highly auspicious day for discharging and clearing debts; courage: undertaking daring assignments requiring boldness; education: securing admission for higher education and university courses; arts: producing artistic and creative works; avoid: travel.
nakshatras.remedies: Mantra: recite or listen to Sri Lalita Sahasranama; Durga: light a pure Ghee lamp at a Durga temple; donation: donate cosmetic kits (Suhag items) to young girls/women; focus: engage in emotional and physical purification.

nakshatras.name: Uttara Ashadha
nakshatras.tagline: Later Victory. Unyielding resilience and enduring success.
nakshatras.predictions: 'Later Victory' - prosperity and triumph materialize firmly after navigating initial hurdles with patient perseverance; possesses unyielding resilience; once established, the native is impossible to suppress; holds 'Aprishya' (unchallenged victory) energy; heavy obligations toward siblings and family (accentuated if Mars is present). Financial abundance is directly linked to charitable giving and philanthropy (Lord Venkateshwara mythos); afflictions cause friction with orthodox traditions (Jupiter debilitation zone); Aquarius Navamsha link may trigger sudden life shifts; growth demands self-sacrifice for the collective good.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Initiations: launching major, long-term enterprises (undefeatable energy); marriage: highly favorable for wedding celebrations; construction: purchasing, building, or moving into residential property; avoid: wrapping up/concluding long tasks and undertaking travel.
nakshatras.remedies: Ganesha: offer fresh laddus and bananas to Lord Ganesha; Sun: offer Surya Arghya (water offering at sunrise); Havan: perform Navagraha Havan offering black sesame seeds; mantra: recite the Ganesh Sankat Nashan Stotra.

nakshatras.name: Shravana
nakshatras.tagline: Hearing. The power of listening and oral tradition.
nakshatras.predictions: Strong auditory learner absorbing wisdom via listening (Shruti); must guard against eavesdropping or indulging in gossip; associated with deep scholarly pursuits, linguistics, and overseas travel; strong link to Saraswati (Goddess of Learning) and the Moon. Success frequently manifests on the 3rd deliberate attempt (Vamana avatar mythos); natives may exhibit an idiosyncratic walking style, limp, or gait; deals with Maya/illusion - realizing situations are seldom as they appear; physical afflictions can impact the ears and hearing.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Learning: writing books, research papers, gaining new knowledge; listening: tuning into educational podcasts, wise counsel, and sacred scriptures; medical: undergoing medical consultations, surgeries, and treatments; avoid: marriages, legal litigation, and unnecessary arguments.
nakshatras.remedies: Vishnu: offer white, yellow, or blue flowers to Lord Vishnu; donation: distribute warm garments and nutritious food to the disabled and destitute; plant: offer water to an Aak (Calotropis) plant; focus: align life with Dharma and charitable works.

nakshatras.name: Dhanishta
nakshatras.tagline: The Wealthiest. Rhythm, timing, and material abundance.
nakshatras.predictions: Flawless sense of timing, cadence, and musical talent; may experience an inner void ('hollow drum') that they attempt to saturate with material achievements; proneness to marital friction where partners live like roommates (Bhishma mythos); themes of celibacy or prolonged delays in marriage. Fiercely protective instincts toward younger siblings and heavy household burdens; uncompromising 'my way or the highway' stance (Mars-Saturn confluence); ambitious career focus, affinity for machinery, heat, and hasty actions; susceptible to lower-leg injuries and blood disorders.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Wealth: executing major financial contracts, real estate acquisitions; arts: music production, performing arts, group collaborations; fitness: high-intensity gym workouts, structured meditation; avoid: signing partnership deeds and deep domestic cleaning.
nakshatras.remedies: Gau Seva: feed soaked red masoor dal (red lentils) to cows; Shiva: offer a miniature Damru at a Shiva temple; donation: donate black shoes to the poor; Durga: offer a silver coin to Goddess Durga.

nakshatras.name: Shatabhisha
nakshatras.tagline: 100 Healers. Secrecy, containment, and complex healing.
nakshatras.predictions: Intricate medical dilemmas that require consults from '100 physicians' to diagnose properly; high affinity for naturopathy, hydrotherapy, and alternative healing modalities; susceptible to escapism via substance abuse/intoxication (Rahu-Varuna energy); secretive, private, and reclusive personality. '1000 Eyes' perspective - panoramic intuition able to detect what escapes others; excels in investigative research, cryptography, and cybersecurity; encloses the true self within an impenetrable barrier; needs to guard against cold emotional detachment.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Healing: scheduling surgeries, medical regimens, therapeutic detoxes; vehicles: favorable period for purchasing automobiles; real estate: buying and selling parcels of land; avoid: shopping for apparel, wedding functions, and legal suits.
nakshatras.remedies: Shiva: offer clean water, milk, and black sesame seeds to the Shivling; 100 Remedy: distribute 100 packets of fresh milk to the poor; diet: observe a periodic fruit or milk fast to detoxify the system; focus: deep physical, emotional, and spiritual healing.

nakshatras.name: Purva Bhadrapada
nakshatras.symbol: Front Legs of Funeral Cot / Two-Faced Man
nakshatras.tagline: The Scorching Pair. Duality, intense penance, and the fire of regret.
nakshatras.predictions: Distinct bifurcated personality - outwardly placid and cordial, while inwardly volatile and intense; frequently wears a social mask to obscure inner turmoil; highly intellectual, capable of transcendent esoteric and spiritual insights (Jupiter); potential to become cynical, obsessively money-minded, or feel spiritually trapped. 'Repentance after action' - marked by impulsive decisions accompanied by deep remorse; driven by temper or an uncompromising pursuit of justice; requires regular periods of austerity and self-purification (Tapasya); prone to ailments of the feet, ankles, and fluid retention.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Technology: developing software, adopting complex modern technologies; risks: stock market operations, speculative trading; endings: completing pending, burdensome obligations; avoid: launching auspicious new projects or celebratory beginnings.
nakshatras.remedies: Tapasya: stand on one leg and chant 'Om Namah Shivaya' 11 times; donation: donate fire elements (firewood/matches) or air items (fans); Shiva: practice mental surrender to Lord Shiva to regulate inner intensity; focus: systematic self-purification and emotional regulation.

nakshatras.name: Uttara Bhadrapada
nakshatras.symbol: Back Legs of Funeral Cot / Serpent
nakshatras.deity: Ahir Budhnya (Serpent of the Deep Ocean)
nakshatras.tagline: The Warrior Priest. Deep spiritual transition and controlled power.
nakshatras.predictions: Gifted with profound endurance and tolerance ('Sahana Shakti'); displays a tranquil demeanor while harboring deep internal strength ('controlled anger'); transmutes turbulent energy into spiritual wisdom; prone to foot and ankle afflictions or chronic rheumatic complaints. Periodic urges toward solitude, detachment, and withdrawal ('Vanaprastha' energy); strong connection to Moksha and the occult sciences; naturally assists others through life endings and major passages (therapy, hospice work); strong karmic role in laying durable foundations.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Partnerships: formalizing marriages and entering long-term commitments; spirituality: dedicated Yogic practices, breathwork, and deep meditation; planting: planting medicinal saplings or Neem trees; avoid: lending currency, filing lawsuits, and unnecessary traveling.
nakshatras.remedies: Cows: feed fresh green fodder to cows (in multiples of 8 kg); Shani: pray to Lord Shani for patience and capacity to bear karma; chant: listen to or recite the Sundarkand; Shiva: offer pure water to Lord Shiva.

nakshatras.name: Revati
nakshatras.tagline: The Wealthy. Completion, nourishment, and guiding souls.
nakshatras.predictions: Natural talent for navigation, wayfinding, mentoring, and guiding lost souls; profoundly tied to foster care, child nourishment, and animal protection (Pushan); exceptional psychic intuition, lucid dreaming, and astral journeys; conceptual fascination with the multiverse. Bestows wealth and abundance; commonly attracts affluent marital partners; physical traits include sensitive teeth/dental issues and a preference for soft foods; must guard against escapist tendencies and debilitating indecision; marks the final stage of spiritual return.
nakshatras.thingsToDo: Arts: music composing, dramatic arts, purchasing musical instruments; nurture: adopting abandoned pets, funding animal shelters, charity; life: conception, performing wedding ceremonies; avoid: entering legal disputes and launching commercial enterprises.
nakshatras.remedies: Pushan: chant 'Om Pushan Devata Namaha'; donation: donate green moong dal or green barfi sweets; diet: drink pure milk regularly to invoke nurturing energy; nature: water an Indian Elm tree.
